questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A fixed mass of gas occupies 300 cm³ at 27°C and 760 mmHg. What volume will it occupy at 127°C and 1520 mmHg?
questions.explanation_short: (P1V1)/T1 = (P2V2)/T2 with T1=300K, T2=400K gives V2 = 200 cm³.
questions.explanation_pidgin: Change °C to Kelvin first (300 K and 400 K). Put inside P1V1/T1 = P2V2/T2: V2 = (760 × 300 × 400) / (300 × 1520) = 200 cm³.
